items.title: RICE-Alpha: Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs for LLM-Agent Stock Forecasting
items.summary: Equity-relevant news evolves through temporally dependent corporate events, making historical information useful only when event continuity, information availability, and transition reliability are modeled.
items.finding: U.S. ablations further show significant reductions in IC and RankIC after Holm adjustment when major components are removed.

items.title: Investor Sentiment and the Low Volatility Anomaly
Affordable Housing, Unaffordable Credit? Concentration and High-Cost Lending for Manufactured Homes
items.summary: This paper shows that high market concentration in the U.S. manufactured home loan market allows lenders to charge markedly higher interest rates than in the mortgage market for site-built homes.
items.finding: Borrowers in counties with higher lender concentration face significantly higher rates, and evidence from bunching at a regulatory rate threshold, an instrumental variable analysis, and a difference-in-differences analysis suggests a causal link.

items.title: Firm Valuation When AI Shapes the Business Model: A Milestone-Based Real-Options Framework for the AI Valuation Uncertainty Problem
items.summary: Standard valuation methods, including discounted cash flow, the income approach standard IDW S 1 of the Institute of Public Auditors in Germany, and market multiples, compress milestone probabilities, continuation options, and risk shifts into opaque aggregate parameters; none provides a structured protocol for…
items.finding: The case is a single-firm demonstration of protocol coherence, not empirical validation; multi-case testing against realised post-exit valuations is left to future research.

items.title: GLOBAL INVESTOR SENTIMENT INDICES AND STOCK RETURN PREDICTABILITY: THE MODERATING ROLE OF GLOBAL ECONOMIC POLICY UNCERTAINTY
items.summary: This study examines whether Global Economic Policy Uncertainty (GEPU) moderates the relationship between investor sentiment and future stock returns using the Emerging Market Sentiment Index (EMSI), the Developed Market Sentiment Index (DMSI), and the Global Market Sentiment Index (GMSI).
items.finding: For EMSI, the results show negative moderation at the 1- and 2-month horizons, whereas for DMSI and GMSI the interaction effects are negative and statistically significant across the 1- to 36-month forecast range, although their magnitudes are generally…

items.title: MARKET EFFICIENCY AND INVESTOR BEHAVIOUR: A COMPARISON OF THE EFFICIENT MARKET HYPOTHESIS AND BEHAVIOURAL FINANCE IN ASSET PRICING
items.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
items.summary: Whether security prices reflect all available information is one of the oldest questions in financial economics, and the answer affects both how investors build portfolios and how regulators supervise markets [1].
items.finding: The thesis concludes that the efficient market hypothesis remains a sound guide to investment practice, while behavioural finance gives the better account of how prices are actually formed [9]..

items.title: ESG Investing and Investor Behavioural Biases: A Systematic Review and Integrated Behavioural Finance Framework: A Systematic Literature Review
items.publisher: Vision for Scientific Research and Publishing LTD
items.venue: International Journal of Financial Administrative and Economic Sciences
items.summary: This paper presents systematic literature review (SLR) based on the PRISMA framework on the nexus of ESG and investor behavioural biases in the stock market.
items.finding: The review indicates that the impact of ESG on stock market investment decisions is mediated by behaviour and not just information.

items.title: FOMO’s Mediation: Herding and Loss Aversion in Gen Z Cryptocurrency Investment Decisions
items.summary: Purpose – This study aims to examine the effects of herding behavior and loss aversion on cryptocurrency investment decisions, with Fear of Missing Out (FOMO) as a mediating variable among Generation Z investors.
items.finding: Findings – The findings indicate that herding behavior, loss aversion, and FOMO have positive and significant effects on cryptocurrency investment decisions.

items.title: Dividend signals, market imperfections and speculative bubble dynamics in an emerging market: Empirical evidence from the Moroccan stock market
items.summary: This study examines the relationship between dividend policy and speculative dynamics in an emerging stock market.
items.finding: This conclusion remains broadly unchanged when dividend variables are lagged, alternative definitions of the intensity indicator are considered, its dynamics are accounted for, and the GSADF/BSADF specification is varied.

items.venue: Journal of Advances in Economics and Management Science
items.summary: The accelerating digitalization of financial information has positioned news sentiment and social media as increasingly influential forces shaping stock market dynamics.
items.finding: This review concludes by outlining a research agenda that emphasizes causal identification strategies, multimodal sentiment decomposition, and adaptive modeling frameworks that can accommodate the rapidly evolving information ecology of modern financial…

items.title: Universal Portfolio Shrinkage
items.summary: We introduce a nonlinear covariance shrinkage method for building optimal portfolios.
items.finding: In empirical applications using a large cross-section of anomaly factors, it delivers robust improvements over alternative shrinkage methods in the literature.

items.title: Original Sin Redux: Role of Duration Risk
items.summary: We highlight the role of duration and exchange rate risks on portfolio flows by using a unique and comprehensive database of U.S. investor flows into emerging market government bonds denominated in local currency.
items.finding: Our analysis highlights the double-edged nature of long-term borrowing and draws attention to market stress dynamics due to strategic complementarities among mutual fund investors.

items.title: Forbearance and the cost of credit
items.summary: Using novel data from the GSE Credit Risk Transfer (CRT) market and the enactment of the 2020 CARES Act as a natural experiment, we study the ex ante pricing of mortgage forbearance.
items.finding: The increase in CRT spreads was larger for securities with greater exposure to judicial foreclosure regimes, lower expected house price growth, higher house price volatility, and riskier borrowers.

items.venue: International Journal of Economics and Finance Studies
items.summary: Growing scrutiny of the ways financial institutions engage with stakeholders and disclose their corporate responsibility activities provides the basis for this study.
items.finding: The empirical evidence demonstrates a positive and statistically significant relationship between CSR disclosure and accounting-based profitability.

items.title: Is Startup Equity a Bad Deal?
items.summary: Imagine joining a startup as employee number 10.
items.finding: The liquidation preference means that the venture capitalists (VCs) who gave the company the $10M, get the higher of 50% of the sale price or their $10M upon exit.
